name: Petrified Legions calls Shadow Bats from physical damage (#1839)
contract: Petrified Legions 500012's single effect is SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL (aura 42) on Call of the Darkwing 801958, a native SPELL_EFFECT_SUMMON with MiscValue 50069 (Shadow Bat), MiscValueB 61 and DieSides 2. Spell.dbc gives 500012 ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so the aura was inert. The tooltip is 'Physical damage you deal or take now has a $h% chance to trigger a Call of the Darkwing' and the record's own ProcChance is 10, which this scenario does not change. Bloodfang Bite rank 572551 is SchoolMask 1 (Physical) and DmgClass 2, matching the row's SchoolMask 1 and its melee-damage-class bits; it needs a Cursed Form for its CasterAuraSpell 525031, supplied by Eternal Curse through the module's marker sync. Melee auto attacks against the same dummy add further physical events. KNOWN STATISTICAL LIMIT: the summoned bats live 15 s (DurationIndex 8), so only the events inside the last 15 s before the assertion can be observed - roughly ten Bloodfang Bites plus about seven white swings. At 10% per event that leaves about 0.9^17, near 17%, chance that a correctly fixed build still fails. That is above the 0.1% bar this repository's scenarios aim for, and the bat lifetime, not the action budget, is the binding constraint. Treat a single failure as inconclusive and re-run; a build without the fix fails every time.
